llmVisionReview.summary: The Home screen and the Marketplace empty state are genuinely production-shaped — the identity card reads 'Signed in as Priya_Nairt Homeowner' with the real role blurb, and Marketplace shows a centered storefront icon plus 'Marketplace is coming to Cedar Commons HOA'. Everything else in this package leaks internals or fails silently: the document detail renders raw schema keys as fact pills ('version', 'accessLevel', 'choice: Open https://cedar-commons-hoa…' behind a broken-chain icon) above a greyed-out 'Save changes' with no reason given; Calendar replaces the seeded reservation with uncontained black body text 'Could not show hoa-res-room-a: event date is missing or invalid' and an off-palette green 'Retry'; and Giving renders literally nothing below its 'Payments, dues, donations, receipts, and ad-off state.' header — no bill, no icon, no sentence, no spinner. Both Calendar and Giving also show a ghosted, ~15%-opacity 'Local package details' row that reads as a half-rendered debug affordance. Giving is the blocker: a homeowner sent to pay dues sees a blank rectangle and cannot distinguish loading from empty from broken.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Across this flow, can the signed-in user always tell who they are (by name), not just which role they are using?
holisticQuestionAnswers.answer: Mostly yes, but not always. Four of the five screens keep a persistent identity card that names the account and the role together, but on the document-detail screen the card has scrolled off entirely and the only identity surface left is the app bar, which reads 'Cedar Commons HOA' with a bell, a chat bubble and a people glyph — no name, no avatar, no role chip.
visibleEvidence: Home screen: 'Signed in as Priya_Nairt' above a bold 'Homeowner', with the blurb and a grey '2 roles' pill on the right.
Document-detail screen: the entire visible page is the Governing Rules v3 card and the blue app bar 'Cedar Commons HOA' — no account name, avatar, or role indicator appears anywhere.
Giving screen: identity persists as 'Signed in as Priya_Nair' / 'Homeowner' at the top of the scroll.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: For the Calendar and Giving tabs specifically, does the screen communicate that this is a genuine empty/error state (as opposed to looking incomplete or broken with no explanation)?
holisticQuestionAnswers.answer: No — and the contrast with Marketplace makes the gap unmistakable. Marketplace uses a centered icon plus community-named headline. Calendar prints a raw parse error with an internal instance slug and an off-palette green Retry. Giving renders nothing at all below its header — no message, no icon, no spinner, no seeded dues bill.
visibleEvidence: Calendar: uncontained black body text reading 'Could not show hoa-res-room-a: event date is missing or invalid' with a green 'Retry' link centered under it.
Giving: the area between the header card and the bottom tab bar is entirely empty white.
Marketplace by comparison: storefront icon plus bold 'Marketplace is coming to Cedar Commons HOA', centered and clearly authored as an empty state.
Calendar and Giving both render a ghosted 'Local package details' row at very low opacity.

findings.title: Giving tab renders completely blank — no dues instance, no empty state, no error
findings.description: Below the Giving header, everything is empty white space down to the tab bar, containing only a ghosted 'Local package details' row. The seeded dues-payment instance does not appear and nothing explains its absence. Marketplace proves the app has a correct empty-state pattern, so this is an unhandled path, not a missing capability. Root cause confirmed independently: the render binding's default role="actor" resolution requires createdByPersonaId == viewer, but hoa-dues-payment is created by hoa-board and paid by hoa-homeowner — a creator-vs-payer mismatch the default binding role never accounts for (see Community JSON Migration Tracker §1a #4).
findings.requiredFix: Either declare role: "any" on the dues-payment render binding (with a corresponding read-visibility scope) or wire a custom rolesForInstance for the Giving tab that checks payerPersonaId rather than createdByPersonaId. Additionally render a real empty state when a persona genuinely has no dues due.

findings.title: Calendar shows a raw developer parse error with an internal instance id instead of the seeded reservation
findings.description: The Calendar tab shows 'Could not show hoa-res-room-a: event date is missing or invalid' as plain uncontained text with an off-palette green Retry. Root cause confirmed independently: the calendar surface (part28_engine_native_calendar_surface.dart:635) hardcodes instanceData['eventDate'] and never consults instanceDataSchema for any other date-typed field name; this fixture's field is named reservationDate (see Community JSON Migration Tracker §1a #2).
findings.requiredFix: Either rename the field to eventDate (or add a computed formula field aliasing it), or make the calendar surface honor a configurable date-field name. Separately, replace the raw error text with a contained error card and remove Retry for non-transient failures.

findings.title: 'Open' fact pill looks tappable while carrying a broken-link icon and a raw 'choice:' URL label
findings.description: The type:"url" field with openMode:"choice" renders per CJM.2's implemented contract (a visibly-labelled unsupported state, since only openMode:"external" is implemented) but the visual differentiation from a live control is too subtle in practice — same fill/shape as neighboring pills, only a small broken-chain icon differs, and the label surfaces the internal 'choice:' discriminator verbatim.
findings.requiredFix: Either land openMode:"external" for this specific field now (avoiding the unsupported state entirely) as a JSON-only change, or improve the unsupported-state visual treatment (stronger dimming, no raw 'choice:' prefix, human label) when CJM.2's embedded/choice follow-on lands.

findings.title: Raw JSON field keys ('version', 'accessLevel') and unmapped enum value ('open') shown to end users
findings.description: Fact pills show 'version' and 'accessLevel' verbatim next to the same fields correctly humanized as 'Version'/'Access Level' in the form below; 'Access Level' value renders as unmapped lowercase 'open'.
findings.requiredFix: Route fact-pill labels and enum values through the same humanization used for form field labels; wrap/ellipsize long URL values.

findings.title: Homeowner sees editable-looking document fields and an unexplained disabled 'Save changes'
findings.description: Title/Version/Open/Access Level render on editable-style underlines with a disabled grey Save button and no explanation, for a persona whose role is read-only on this document.
findings.requiredFix: Render read-only for personas without edit rights (no input underlines, no Save). Confirm via a focused-field capture whether inputs actually accept input.

findings.title: Half-opacity 'Local package details' developer row visible on Calendar and Giving
findings.description: Both tabs render a ~15%-opacity 'Local package details' row with a chevron — looks half-painted, and is developer vocabulary that should never reach a resident.
findings.requiredFix: Gate this row behind a developer/authoring mode so it never renders for member personas.

findings.title: Account name and role disappear once the identity card scrolls out of view
findings.description: On the document-detail screen the identity card has scrolled away and the app bar shows no name/avatar/role — only 'Cedar Commons HOA' plus icons.
findings.requiredFix: Add a persistent identity affordance to the app bar that survives scrolling and tab changes; label the '2 roles' control explicitly.

findings.title: Platform jargon in resident-facing copy: 'unassigned community surfaces' and 'ad-off state'
findings.description: Home's section subtitle and Giving's subtitle both expose internal platform taxonomy/monetization vocabulary. Home also leads with an empty sponsored-message banner.
findings.requiredFix: Replace platform taxonomy with resident language; hide the sponsored-message slot entirely when empty.

findings.title: Fourth bottom-nav tab 'Giving' is clipped at the right screen edge on all five screens
findings.description: The bottom nav consistently cuts the fourth tab off at the right edge with no overflow indicator, regardless of selection state.
findings.requiredFix: Size the tab bar so all tabs fit, or make it horizontally scrollable with a visible edge fade.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Across this flow, can the signed-in user always tell who they are (by name), not just which role they are using?
holisticQuestionAnswers.answer: Mostly yes, but not always. Four of the five screens keep a persistent identity card that names the account and the role together, but on the document-detail screen the card has scrolled off entirely and the only identity surface left is the app bar, which reads 'Cedar Commons HOA' with a bell, a chat bubble and a people glyph — no name, no avatar, no role chip.
visibleEvidence: Home screen: 'Signed in as Priya_Nairt' above a bold 'Homeowner', with the blurb and a grey '2 roles' pill on the right.
Document-detail screen: the entire visible page is the Governing Rules v3 card and the blue app bar 'Cedar Commons HOA' — no account name, avatar, or role indicator appears anywhere.
Giving screen: identity persists as 'Signed in as Priya_Nair' / 'Homeowner' at the top of the scroll.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: For the Calendar and Giving tabs specifically, does the screen communicate that this is a genuine empty/error state (as opposed to looking incomplete or broken with no explanation)?
holisticQuestionAnswers.answer: No — and the contrast with Marketplace makes the gap unmistakable. Marketplace uses a centered icon plus community-named headline. Calendar prints a raw parse error with an internal instance slug and an off-palette green Retry. Giving renders nothing at all below its header — no message, no icon, no spinner, no seeded dues bill.
visibleEvidence: Calendar: uncontained black body text reading 'Could not show hoa-res-room-a: event date is missing or invalid' with a green 'Retry' link centered under it.
Giving: the area between the header card and the bottom tab bar is entirely empty white.
Marketplace by comparison: storefront icon plus bold 'Marketplace is coming to Cedar Commons HOA', centered and clearly authored as an empty state.
Calendar and Giving both render a ghosted 'Local package details' row at very low opacity.

findings.title: Giving tab renders completely blank — no dues instance, no empty state, no error
findings.description: Below the Giving header, everything is empty white space down to the tab bar, containing only a ghosted 'Local package details' row. The seeded dues-payment instance does not appear and nothing explains its absence. Marketplace proves the app has a correct empty-state pattern, so this is an unhandled path, not a missing capability. Root cause confirmed independently: the render binding's default role="actor" resolution requires createdByPersonaId == viewer, but hoa-dues-payment is created by hoa-board and paid by hoa-homeowner — a creator-vs-payer mismatch the default binding role never accounts for (see Community JSON Migration Tracker §1a #4).
findings.requiredFix: Either declare role: "any" on the dues-payment render binding (with a corresponding read-visibility scope) or wire a custom rolesForInstance for the Giving tab that checks payerPersonaId rather than createdByPersonaId. Additionally render a real empty state when a persona genuinely has no dues due.
